In 1 minute

Indirect tax filing pre-check (EFD ICMS/IPI)

David · Indirect Tax Analyst

A food manufacturer with three branches in two states generates an EFD ICMS/IPI file (digital tax bookkeeping) every month with more than 400 thousand records per branch.

When it runs
Between the 8th and the 12th of each month, each time the ERP generates the EFD ICMS/IPI TXT file for a branch, before the final validation in the Receita Federal (federal tax authority) program and the submission by the state's deadline
What it delivers in production
Each time the file is generated the senior analyst receives the divergences by CFOP and CST, the invoices with the wrong status, the tax calculation match and the state checklist, and decides what to correct before submitting.
Who decides
Checks and recommends; the senior analyst submits
Effort
Calibrate on three amended EFDs; two months
Set up5 steps · 8 ready files

# State rules: EFD ICMS/IPI, MG branch

Example. Replace it with your tax consultancy's version.

EFD ICMS/IPI is the monthly SPED (tax digital bookkeeping) file for ICMS and IPI. SEFAZ is the state tax authority that authorizes each NF-e (Brazilian electronic invoice). CIAP is the control of ICMS credit on fixed assets.

## Deadlines of the month
- Own ICMS: payment by the 12th of the following month.
- DeSTDA (state return for ICMS tax substitution and rate differential): by the 19th of the following month.
- EFD ICMS/IPI: by the 25th of the following month.

## Allowed adjustment codes (E111)
| Code | Use |
|---|---|
| MG020005 | Presumed credit under the branch's special regime |
| MG000002 | Debit reversal for a documented return |
| MG010003 | Other debits for rate differential |
A code outside this list is not accepted. No code in the list fits: CONSULT THE CONSULTANCY.

## Reading the file
- The C190 of each invoice carries CST, CFOP, VL_OPR, VL_BC_ICMS and VL_ICMS. The match compares VL_OPR with product_amount from the XML.
- COD_SIT 00 in C100 is a regular (authorized) invoice.
- CFOP 1551 and 2551 are fixed-asset purchases. The credit comes through CIAP in block G (G110 and G125). G001 with indicator 1 is a block without movement.
- Prior credit balance: VL_SLD_CREDOR_ANT in the current E110 must equal VL_SLD_CREDOR_TRANSPORTAR in the E110 of the prior file.

## Who decides
| Finding | Action | Who decides |
|---|---|---|
| Difference per CFOP up to R$ 500.00 from rounding | record | analyst |
| Invoice canceled or denied in the file, or authorized invoice missing | regenerate | senior analyst |
| Base difference from R$ 500 to R$ 20 thousand | regenerate | senior analyst |
| Adjustment code outside the list | correct with an allowed code | senior analyst |
| Divergent credit balance or fixed asset without block G | regenerate | tax coordinator, with the consultancy |
| ICMS difference above R$ 20 thousand | regenerate | tax coordinator, with the consultancy |
When more than one row applies, all of them apply.

## Rules with no leeway
- Match only against authorized XMLs of the file's branch. E.g.: invoice 9112 belongs to the SP branch and stays out; 4504, canceled on Oct 30, counts in the EFD and not in the XML.
- CFOP 6101 CST 000: EFD R$ 120,000.00 (4503 + 4504) against XML R$ 105,000.00 (4503 + 4505). Two causes: 4504 canceled but in the file, and 4505 authorized but missing. Regenerate, senior analyst.
- Rounding is a tolerance only up to R$ 500.00. E.g.: CFOP 5405 CST 060, R$ 0.36: record.
- A fixed asset without block G goes to the coordinator. E.g.: invoice 3381, CFOP 2551, R$ 90,000.00, with G001 without movement.
- EFD balance = debits - credits - credit adjustments - prior credit balance. E.g.: EFD 41,400 - 9,000 - 2,000 - 2,100 = R$ 28,300.00; ERP 41,400 - 9,000 - 1,200 - 3,500 = R$ 27,700.00; difference R$ 600.00.
- Deadline within the next 10 calendar days: from today to today + 10, inclusive. E.g.: from Nov 10 to Nov 20.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The agent does not submit the EFD, does not change the TXT and does not write to the system; it flags and the senior analyst corrects at the source, because a hand-edited file breaks the traceability of the bookkeeping. An invoice canceled at SEFAZ that appears as authorized blocks submission; it is not an adjustment. An adjustment code is only suggested if it is on the attached state list; the agent does not interpret state legislation beyond what the consultancy wrote. The report is archived with the submitted TXT, as evidence for inspections.

Common mistakes

  • Relying only on the Receita Federal validator, which checks structure and does not check whether a canceled invoice stayed in the file as authorized.
  • Matching overall ICMS totals without breaking them down by CFOP and CST; differences in opposite directions cancel out.
  • Forgetting the credit balance carried forward from the previous month after an amendment, calculating too much or too little tax the following month.
  • Applying the same adjustment rule and the same deadline to branches in different states.

Metrics
